items.where: ground storey, the whole front: seven chamfered-head openings (flat head, straight shoulders) between dark brick piers, a rough-rendered concrete lintel band over them, the shops set back behind a walk
items.how: kit: ground "arcade" (chamfered openings cut ~2.4 m deep, four-light shopfronts with a transom at the back, rendered soffit, lintel band following the shoulders, pier facings) on the large-tier wall group

items.where: one two-sided (prismatic) erker per bay on storeys 1-3, three lights each with a small pitched cap over the top one
items.how: builder hook: a prism erker (front and two angled cheeks, frames and glass, slab caps) per bay axis over storeys 1-3

items.where: a single two-light sash window either side of each erker on storeys 1-3, cream frames
items.how: builder: framed windows laid on the kit wall (cream 10 cm frame ring, glass, bars, stone sill as closed boxes), two per bay beside the erker; the kit leaves the arcade front's upper storeys to the builder

items.where: eight hoist beams at the parapet with a vertical iron post ending in two curled (ram's horn) scrolls, one over every pier axis ("hijsbalken met dubbele en gekrulde metalen elementen", register 527135)
items.how: builder: beam stub through the parapet, iron post, two scrolls as closed polygonal spirals in the dark slot

items.where: dark brick course along the top of the rendered lintel band at ~5 m
items.how: builder: dark band strip over the arcade band

items.where: thin dark coping along the flat-roof parapet
items.how: builder coping strip

items.where: tenant signs and flags (Blokker, Pearle, Hizi Hair) in and under the arcade

skip.note: shop tenants change; the 2018 and 2022 crops already differ

walls.note: The north arcade front on the square, 43.7 m: four storeys, seven arcade bays on a 6.1 m pitch, a two-sided erker per bay over three storeys; the clock tower stands behind its east end. Crops 2018-11 (overcast) and 2022-05 (sun). 1990s reconstruction of Berlage's 1925-27 front (nl.wikipedia Mercatorplein (Amsterdam)).

items.where: ground storey: a 5.9 m wide underpass with a chamfered head (jambs to ~3.6 m, flat head ~4.8 m) in a rough-rendered frame that steps up in two shoulders to ~6.1 m, a dark soldier course on top; the render band runs across the whole front at 3.0-4.95 m over a dark brick plinth
items.how: builder: real through-passage (jambs, chamfered shoulders and rendered soffit through the gate), stepped render frame as a closed plate, plinth and render band plates

items.where: pedestrian doors beside the underpass in the dark brick plinth
items.how: builder: dark recessed door panels

items.where: first and second storey over the underpass: a three-sided erker (3.7 m wide, 3 lights in front, 2 rows) with a stone cap bent up at the ends, flanked by a tall two-row window either side
items.how: builder: prism erker with frames, glazing bars and a slab cap; flank windows as framed openings

items.where: steep transverse saddle roof in blue-grey tiles with a flat top, a white eaves board at ~12.2 m, a glazed roof-light strip along the eaves (1990s) and two skylights
items.how: builder: two tiled slopes and the flat top from 3DBAG LoD2.2 heights, white eaves board, dark glass strip

items.where: the north tower: a brick shaft 6 m wide rising to 37.4 m on the square side of a 32.4 m main block, flat roofs with thin copings (rebuilt 1995-98 after its 1961 demolition)
items.how: builder: hand massing from 3DBAG LoD2.2 roof heights, not the 3DBAG shell

items.where: white clock dials with dark hour bars and hands near the top of the shaft, seen on its south, west and east faces
items.how: builder: dial disc proud of the shaft, 12 hour bars, hour and minute hands; one per seen face
items.note: east face seen from Hoofdweg (pano TMX7316010203-001878_pano_0005_002651, 2020-08); the north face was not seen and has no dial

items.where: a long narrow vertical recess under the dial on the shaft's south face
items.how: builder: dark recessed strip

items.where: paired narrow windows stacked up the shaft
items.how: builder: paired framed openings per stage

items.where: small balconies with white slab undersides in the angles between the shaft and the main block, curved in plan, stacked on both sides
items.how: builder: quarter-round slab and solid parapet as closed polygonal prisms, three per side

items.where: small single windows in a column on the tower base beside the gate
items.how: builder: framed openings
